title: Build the Dihedral-Equivalence Matrix Ignoring Color
written_solution: Treat the four panels as binary shapes, ignoring their colors. Two shapes match if one can be turned into the other by a rotation or a mirror flip. Output a 4×4 matrix whose cells are cyan(8) exactly where the corresponding pair of panels is dihedrally equivalent.
